info.name: Harbor — MCP Governance (E2E)
info.description: The governance lifecycle over real MCP 2026-07-28 calls: allow / deny / approval-required, MRTR approval + resume, the HTTP fallback channel, a multi-step workflow with two approvals, denial, replay, idempotency, error cases, security and audit. Needs the E2E environment: `npm run governance:up`. Requests chain through collection variables; run folders top to bottom. Generated by tests/postman/build-collection.mts.

item.description: Liveness of the gateway and the mock backend.

item.name: 14 - Audit
item.description: Decisions, approvals and the derived history are the audit trail — no log scraping.

item.name: Inspect the multi-step execution — decisions, approvals, history

exec: pm.test('every decision carries reason and rule versions', () => insp.decisions.forEach(d => { pm.expect(d.reason).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.ruleVersions).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.evaluatedAt).to.be.a('string'); }));

pm.test('approval-required decisions name their owner and rule', () => { const d = insp.decisions.find(x => x.decision === 'REQUIRE_APPROVAL'); pm.expect(d.ruleVersions[0]).to.match(/^(gateway|[a-z0-9-]+)\/[a-z0-9-]+@[^#]+#[0-9a-f]{12}$/); });

pm.test('history is chronological and complete', () => { const ev = insp.history.map(h => h.kind + ':' + h.event + (h.sequence ?
